title.zh: MoE 系统工程：DeepEP 与 DeepGEMM
title.en: MoE systems engineering: DeepEP and DeepGEMM

subtitle.zh: 20天打通专家路由、计算、通信与作品验证
subtitle.en: 20 days from expert routing to computation, communication and evidence

description.zh: 从四个可手算的CPU专家出发，逐步理解dispatch/combine、专家负载、低精度误差、通信下界和真实测量。交付可运行的路由与聚合代码、20份实验记录和一份诚实的性能分析作品。
description.en: Start with four hand-checkable CPU experts, then study dispatch/combine, load balance, quantization error, transfer bounds and measurements. Deliver routing/combine code, twenty experiment records and an honest analysis portfolio.

hoursPerDay.en: 90–120 minutes daily; GPU extensions take additional time

prerequisites.zh: Python列表/函数、矩阵乘法；建议先完成系统基础、Triton和NCCL课程

hardware.zh: 必做：普通CPU、Python 3.9+，无第三方依赖。可选GPU扩展需匹配固定上游commit的Linux、GPU、CUDA、PyTorch与通信环境，未做本平台GPU验证。
hardware.en: Required: CPU and Python 3.9+, no third-party dependencies. Optional GPU work needs Linux, GPU, CUDA, PyTorch and communication dependencies matching pinned upstream commits; this platform has not validated GPU execution.

lesson.zh: 一个Token选中两个专家，就会产生两个专家工作项。Dispatch按照专家分桶；Token数仍是T，工作项数是T×k。把这两者混淆会造成容量估计错误，或者错误地把重复Token当成重复请求删除。

title.zh: 专家计算：从小矩阵理解 GEMM
title.en: Understand expert GEMM with small matrices

lesson.zh: 本实验专家接收长度4的向量：对角权重为专家ID+1，其他位置为0.125。四个专家执行相同形状但不同参数的线性变换。真实MoE常包含更多线性层、激活与门控；先把这一层算对，再讨论优化。
lesson.en: Each lab expert receives a width-4 vector. Diagonal weights equal expert ID+1 and off-diagonal weights equal 0.125. Experts share shapes but not parameters. Real MoEs often include more projections, activations and gates; establish this layer’s correctness first.

body.zh: 对于M×H乘H×N的矩阵乘法，常用运算量约为2MHN，乘与加各计一次。它是工作量约定，不是Python实际执行的机器指令数。批量把同一专家的Token合并成矩阵，才能讨论分组GEMM和不同M带来的效率变化。
body.en: For M×H times H×N, a conventional work count is approximately 2MHN FLOPs, counting multiply and add separately. This is not a Python instruction count. Grouping tokens for one expert makes M explicit and prepares us to analyze grouped GEMM efficiency.
